title: Call Tracking for Real Estate: Trace Every Enquiry
h1: Call tracking for real estate: trace every enquiry to its source
description: Call tracking for real estate shows which portals, ads and signs make buyers and renters call. See how to set it up and cut wasted spend.
faq: What is call tracking for real estate?
It gives each portal, ad or sign its own phone number so every enquiry call is linked to the source that produced it.
Which real estate channels should I track first?
Start with your top three: usually a property portal, a paid ad campaign and your website, then add boards and print.
Can I record property enquiry calls?
Recording rules differ by country, so check your obligations, including any required notice, with your own counsel first.
body:
Call tracking for real estate means giving each listing portal, ad campaign or sign its own phone number, so every enquiry call is traced back to the source that produced it. Property buyers and renters often prefer to phone, and without tracking you only see the portal or ad you paid for, not the calls it actually created.

Why call tracking for real estate matters

Agents and developers usually spend on several channels at once: property portals, social ads, search ads, printed brochures and boards outside the property. A buyer in London may ring from a portal listing, a renter in Dubai may call after a social ad, and a seller in Sydney may phone the number on a board. Without a separate number per source, all of those calls look the same in your reports.

Tracking helps you answer practical questions: which channel brings valuable seller enquiries, which listings generate calls that go unanswered, and which campaign deserves more budget. Number formats, portals and customs differ by country, but the underlying problem is the same everywhere.

What to track in a property business

  • Portal listings: a dedicated number per portal or per listing group, so you can compare portals side by side.
  • Paid ads: one number per campaign or keyword source, whether the ad runs in Mumbai, Toronto or Berlin.
  • Offline media: boards, flyers, brochures and magazine ads each carry their own number.
  • Website visitors: dynamic number insertion shows each visitor a number tied to how they arrived.
  • Web forms: valuation requests and viewing bookings through your site should be credited to a source too, so calls and forms can be compared. See our guide to form lead tracking.

From a call to a decision

A tracked call is more useful when you can listen back and review it. With recordings and AI transcripts in the language you choose, a sales manager can check how enquiries were handled, spot missed follow-ups and see what buyers actually ask. Recording rules differ by country, so check your obligations, including any notice you must play, with your own counsel before switching recording on.

Quality matters too. A source that sends many very short calls may be sending the wrong audience or misdialled numbers. Grading sources lets you see that pattern instead of guessing.

Working with agents, brokers and referral partners

Many property businesses pay for leads: referral partners, lead generators or affiliate marketers send enquiries and are paid per qualified call. That is the pay-per-call model, and it needs a record both sides trust. If you are sending property calls to buyers such as brokerages or mortgage providers, see how call tracking software and the pay-per-call industries hub work together. Payout rates per partner and downloadable statements keep the money side clear.

How to do it in Insight Dial

  1. Create a campaign for each channel, such as a portal, a social ad set or a printed board.
  2. Assign each its own tracking number, and use dynamic number insertion on your website pages.
  3. Turn on call recording and AI transcription in the language you choose, with a spoken notice where your rules need one.
  4. Add tracking links for web campaigns and capture form submissions so calls, clicks and form leads sit side by side.
  5. Set alerts to Slack, Discord, Teams or WhatsApp so a missed enquiry does not wait until Monday.
  6. Use the test-call tool and setup checklist before going live. See call features and pricing.

Insight Dial can be used by businesses in any country, so a single team can compare calls from several markets in one place. Pricing is pay as you go: a per-minute call rate plus a monthly price per tracking number from a topped-up balance.

A simple starting plan

Start small. Give your top three channels their own numbers, run them for a month, and compare calls by source. Then listen to a sample of recordings from each. Move budget only when the pattern is clear, and keep adding numbers as you add channels.
